## Scope

The 2026 Q2 grading quality audit examined a sample of 547 graded sets. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess consistency between the original and repeat grades. The review focused on the level of agreement between the two grading decisions. It was intended to provide a practical check on grading quality across the sample and to identify any variation requiring follow-up.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 60.5 per cent of sets reviewed. This provides the overall agreement result for the audit sample. Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately to support appropriate feedback and follow-up. The spreadsheet should be used alongside those discussions when reviewing individual results.
